text:
Travis Konecny returned to the Philadelphia lineup on November 1 after missing most of October with an injury, and he marked the night with a goal and an assist in a 6-3 win over Utah. Yahoo Sports called his and Owen Tippett's returns big reinforcements, and Flyers Nitty Gritty had him firing back at people who don't believe in the Flyers. After two quiet games since, the team has lost both.

Eight games is too small a sample to say much about his season. He has five points, 11 shots, and his ice time has dipped to 17 minutes while he works back. His shooting (9.1 percent) and his teammates' finishing are both running cold, so the early numbers undersell him a little. Our projection still puts him around 53 points over the games left.

The longer view is the one to watch. Evolving-Hockey had him near replacement level last season (0.3 wins), with opponents generating a lot when he was on the ice (bottom 6 percent of forwards), a sharp drop for a player who has spent all 728 of his NHL games in Philadelphia. The Flyers need the old Konecny, energy and offense both.
headline: Konecny is back, and the Flyers needed him
